emailRequired: Your account has no email address.
popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window.
signInFailed: Sign-in did not finish. Please try again.
serverError: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
consoleUnreachable: The console could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
validationFailed: Some values were not accepted. Check the form and try again.
dappNotFound: This dApp no longer exists. Reload to see the current state.
dappAlreadyExists: This email already has a dApp; each email can have one dApp at a time. Reload to see it.
invalidTransition: That action is not possible in the dApp's current state. Reload to see it.
noPendingChange: There is no change waiting for review any more. Reload to see the current state.
dappChanged: This dApp changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version, then try again.
provisioningRejected: Auth0 refused this change, so the console saved nothing. Trying again will not help until the cause is fixed. Contact the NEAR Auth team.
provisioningFailed: The console could not finish this in Auth0, so it saved nothing. Try again in a few minutes, and contact the NEAR Auth team if it keeps failing.
rateLimited: Too many changes in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
forbiddenRole: You don't have access to this page.
ownerAlreadyHasDapp: That email already owns a dApp. Each email can own one.
adminProvisioningRejected: Auth0, or the console's check of the client's tag, refused this, so the console saved nothing. Its error is shown under "The last Auth0 call failed".
adminProvisioningFailed: The console could not finish this in Auth0, so it saved nothing, though Auth0 may already hold part of it. Try again in a few minutes; the error is shown under "The last Auth0 call failed".
settingsChanged: Another admin was changing this setting at the same time, so it was not saved. Try again.
